business_summary: Quants Research Institute Holdings, Inc. engages in the mergers and acquisitions (M&A) intermediary activities in Japan. It operates M&A sites and media. The company serves various industries comprising construction, human resources, IT/communication/system development, transportation, real estate, treatment/welfare/nursing, finance/insurance, travel, food and beverages, education, retail, service, manufacturing, leisure facilities, and environment/bio. The company was formerly known as M&A Research Institute Holdings Inc. and changed its name to Quants Research Institute Holdings, Inc. in January 2026. Quants Research Institute Holdings, Inc. was incorporated in 2018 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
business_summary_ko: Quants Research Institute Holdings, Inc.는 일본에서 인수합병(M&A) 중개 활동에 참여하고 있습니다. M&A 사이트와 미디어를 운영하고 있습니다. 건설, 인사, IT/통신/시스템 개발, 교통, 부동산, 의료/복지/간호, 금융/보험, 여행, 식음료, 교육, 소매, 서비스, 제조, 레저 시설, 환경/바이오 등 다양한 산업 분야에 서비스를 제공하고 있습니다. 이 회사는 이전에 M&A Research Institute Holdings Inc.로 알려졌으며 2026년 1월에 Quants Research Institute Holdings, Inc.로 이름을 변경했습니다. Quants Research Institute Holdings, Inc.는 2018년에 법인화되었으며 일본 도쿄에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
